title: Runs agree on queries made
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine, let $O$ and $O'$ be oracle languages, and let $x$ be an input word. If membership in $O$ and $O'$ agrees for every query string submitted by $M$ during the first $t$ steps of its run on $x$ with oracle $O$, then the configurations reached after $t$ steps on $x$ using $O$ and $O'$ are equal.
hypotheses_covered: Membership in O and O' agrees on every query made during the first t steps of the run using O
